evidence.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā dve sotāni tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti? Yañca, bhikkhave, tassa dīpassa uttarante udakaṃ, yañca dakkhiṇante udakaṃ – ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā dve sotāni tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti. Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yaṃ saddhindriyaṃ taṃ saddhābalaṃ, yaṃ saddhābalaṃ taṃ saddhindriyaṃ; yaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ taṃ vīriyabalaṃ, yaṃ vīriyabalaṃ taṃ vīriyindriyaṃ; yaṃ satindriyaṃ taṃ satibalaṃ , yaṃ satibalaṃ taṃ satindriyaṃ; yaṃ samādhindriyaṃ taṃ samādhibalaṃ, yaṃ samādhibalaṃ taṃ samādhindriyaṃ; yaṃ paññindriyaṃ taṃ paññābalaṃ, yaṃ paññābalaṃ taṃ paññindriyaṃ. Pañcannaṃ, bhikkhave, indriyānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’’ti. Tatiyaṃ.
evidence.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，是何理趣，依此理趣，那条河可计为二流呢？比丘们，那岛屿北端的水，以及南端的水——比丘们，此即是理趣，依此理趣，那条河可计为二流。同样地，比丘们，信根即是信力，信力即是信根；精进根即是精进力，精进力即是精进根；念根即是念力，念力即是念根；定根即是定力，定力即是定根；慧根即是慧力，慧力即是慧根。比丘们，比丘修习、多修习这五根，由于诸漏已尽，便能于现法中亲自证知、现证无漏的心解脱、慧解脱而住。”第三经。
evidence.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is the reason by which that river comes to be reckoned as ‘two streams’? The water, bhikkhus, at the northern end of that island and the water at the southern end—this, indeed, bhikkhus, is the reason by which that river comes to be reckoned as ‘two streams’. In this very same way, bhikkhus, that which is the faculty of faith is the power of faith; that which is the power of faith is the faculty of faith. That which is the faculty of energy is the power of energy; that which is the power of energy is the faculty of energy. That which is the faculty of mindfulness is the power of mindfulness; that which is the power of mindfulness is the faculty of mindfulness. That which is the faculty of concentration is the power of concentration; that which is the power of concentration is the faculty of concentration. That which is the faculty of wisdom is the power of wisdom; that which is the power of wisdom is the faculty of wisdom. Bhikkhus, due to having developed and frequently practiced the five faculties, a bhikkhu, through the destruction of the taints, dwells having attained the taintless liberation of mind, liberation by wisdom, having realized it for himself with direct knowledge in this very life.” The third.

entries.pali: Saddhābalādīsupi saddhādīni vuttatthāneva. Akampiyaṭṭhena pana balanti veditabbaṃ. Evametesu assaddhiye na kampatīti saddhābalaṃ . Kosajje na kampatīti vīriyabalaṃ . Muṭṭhassacce na kampatīti satibalaṃ . Uddhacce na kampatīti samādhibalaṃ . Avijjāya na kampatīti paññābalaṃ . Ahirike na kampatīti hiribalaṃ . Anottappe na kampatīti ottappabala nti. Ayaṃ ubhayapadavasena atthavaṇṇanā hoti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 于信力等中，信等之义亦如前说。然应知“力”以不动摇为义。如此，于此等[力]中：不为不信所动摇，故为信力；不为懈怠所动摇，故为精进力；不为失念所动摇，故为念力；不为掉举所动摇，故为定力；不为无明所动摇，故为慧力；不为无惭所动摇，故为惭力；不为无愧所动摇，故为愧力。此为依二词之义释。
entries.english: In the terms beginning with the faith-power, 'faith' and the other terms have the same meaning as already stated. However, 'power' should be understood in the sense of being unshakable. Thus, among these: it is the 'faith-power' because it is not shaken by faithlessness; it is the 'energy-power' because it is not shaken by laziness; it is the 'mindfulness-power' because it is not shaken by forgetfulness; it is the 'concentration-power' because it is not shaken by restlessness; it is the 'wisdom-power' because it is not shaken by ignorance; it is the 'moral shame-power' because it is not shaken by shamelessness; it is the 'moral dread-power' because it is not shaken by lack of moral dread. This is the explanation of the meaning by way of both terms.

entries.pali: Etesu hi cittaṃ tāva phassapañcakaṃ patvā cittaṃ hotīti vuttaṃ, indriyāni patvā manindriyanti. Vitakko jhānaṅgāni patvā vitakko hotīti vutto, maggaṅgāni patvā sammāsaṅkappoti. Saddhā indriyāni patvā saddhindriyaṃ hotīti vuttā, balāni patvā saddhābalanti. Hirī balāni patvā hiribalaṃ hotīti vuttā, lokapāladukaṃ patvā hirīti. Ottappepi eseva nayo. Alobho mūlaṃ patvā alobho hotīti vutto, kammapathaṃ patvā anabhijjhāti. Adoso mūlaṃ patvā adoso hotīti vutto, kammapathaṃ patvā abyāpādoti. Ime satta dvīsu ṭhānesu vibhattā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 于此等法中，首先，心于触五法(phassapañcaka)中，被称为心；于诸根中，被称为意根。寻(vitakka)于禅支中，被称为寻；于道支中，被称为正思惟(sammāsaṅkappa)。信(saddhā)于诸根中，被称为信根；于诸力中，被称为信力。惭(hirī)于诸力中，被称为惭力；于守护世间二法(lokapāladuka)中，被称为惭。愧(ottappa)亦同此理。无贪(alobha)于（善）根中，被称为无贪；于业道中，被称为无贪欲(anabhijjhā)。无瞋(adosa)于（善）根中，被称为无瞋；于业道中，被称为无瞋恚(abyāpāda)。
entries.english: Indeed, among these, firstly, consciousness, having reached the pentad with contact as its fifth member, is spoken of as 'consciousness'; having reached the faculties, it is spoken of as the 'mind faculty'. Initial application, having reached the absorption factors, is spoken of as 'initial application'; having reached the path factors, it is spoken of as 'Right Intention'. Faith, having reached the faculties, is spoken of as the 'faculty of faith'; having reached the powers, it is spoken of as the 'power of faith'. Moral shame, having reached the powers, is spoken of as the 'power of moral shame'. The same method applies to moral dread. Non-greed, having reached the roots, is spoken of as 'non-greed'; having reached the courses of action, it is spoken of as 'non-covetousness'. Non-hatred, having reached the roots, is spoken of as 'non-hatred'; having reached the courses of action, it is spoken of as 'non-ill will'. Thus, these seven states are divided into two instances.

entries.pali: 12 . Saddhindriyaniddese buddhādiguṇānaṃ saddahanavasena saddhā . Buddhādīni vā ratanāni saddahati pattiyāyatīti saddhā. Saddahanā ti saddahanākāro. Buddhādīnaṃ guṇe ogāhati, bhinditvā viya anupavisatīti okappanā . Buddhādīnaṃ guṇesu etāya sattā ativiya pasīdanti, sayaṃ vā abhippasīdatīti abhippasādo . Idāni yasmā saddhindriyādīnaṃ samāsapadānaṃ vasena aññasmiṃ pariyāye āraddhe ādipadaṃ gahetvāva padabhājanaṃ karīyati – ayaṃ abhidhamme dhammatā – tasmā puna saddhā ti vuttaṃ. Yathā vā itthiyā indriyaṃ itthindriyaṃ, na tathā idaṃ. Idaṃ pana saddhāva indriyaṃ saddhindriyanti. Evaṃ samānādhikaraṇabhāvañāpanatthampi puna saddhāti vuttaṃ. Evaṃ sabbapadaniddesesu ādipadassa puna vacane payojanaṃ veditabbaṃ. Adhimokkhalakkhaṇe indaṭṭhaṃ kāretīti saddhindriyaṃ . Asaddhiye na kampatīti saddhābalaṃ .
entries.chinese_simplified: 12. 在信根的解释中，对佛陀等的功德深信不疑，是为信(saddhā)。或者说，确信佛陀等宝，并虔诚归向，是为信。深信(saddahanā)即是深信的状态。沉浸于佛陀等的功德中，仿佛穿透般地深入，是为确信(okappanā)。众生因此对佛陀等的功德生起极大的净信，或者自身生起清净的信心，是为净信(abhippasādo)。现在，由于信根等复合词在其他解释中，都是以首词为基础进行词义分解——这是阿毗达摩(abhidhamma)的通例——所以再次说‘信’。这不像‘女根’(itthindriyaṃ)是‘女性之根’(itthiyā indriyaṃ)，此(信根)非如此。此(信根)乃是信即是根，故为信根。为了表明这种同格关系，也再次说‘信’。如此，在所有词的解释中，重复首词的用意应当了知。于胜解相中行使主导作用，故为信根。不为不信所动摇，故为信力。
entries.english: 12. In the exposition of the faculty of faith, saddhā (faith) is so called by means of believing in the qualities of the Buddha and so on. Or, it is saddhā because one believes in and relies upon the jewels such as the Buddha. Believing (saddahanā) is the mode of believing. It is okappanā (placing trust) because it enters the qualities of the Buddha and so on, penetrating as if breaking through. By means of it, beings become exceedingly serene towards the qualities of the Buddha and so on; or, it itself becomes exceedingly serene, thus it is abhippasāda (profound serenity). Now, because when another method is undertaken for compound words such as saddhindriya, the word analysis is done by taking the first word—this is the nature (dhammatā) in the Abhidhamma—therefore, 'faith' is stated again. Or, this is not like the case of itthindriya (the female faculty), which is 'a woman's faculty'. Rather, here, faith itself is the faculty, thus saddhindriya. Thus, 'faith' is stated again also to make known the state of having the same referent. In this way, the purpose for the repetition of the initial word in all expositions of terms should be understood. It is the faculty of faith (saddhindriya) because it exercises sovereignty in the characteristic of determination. It is the power of faith (saddhābala) because it is not shaken by faithlessness.

entries.pali: Ajjhattikabāhiresu dvādasasu āyatanesu kāmabhavavibhavataṇhāvasena dvādasa tikā chattiṃsa taṇhāvicaritāni . Khuddakavatthuvibhaṅge vā āgatanayena kālavibhāgaṃ anāmasitvā vuttāni. Vīmaṃsiddhipādādayo bodhipakkhiyā kiccanānattena vuttā, atthato ekattā sammādiṭṭhimukhena tattha antogadhā. Tayo nekkhammavitakkādayo ti lokiyakkhaṇe alobhamettākaruṇāsampayogavasena bhinnā maggakkhaṇe lobhabyāpādavihiṃsāsamucchedavasena tayoti ekopi vutto. Esa nayo sammāvācādīsu. Appicchatāsantuṭṭhitānaṃ pana bhāve sammāājīvasambhavato tena tesaṃ saṅgaho daṭṭhabbo. Bhavantarepi jīvitahetupi ariyehi avītikkamanīyattā ariyakantānaṃ sammāvācādisīlānaṃ gahaṇena yena saddhāhatthena tāni pariggahetabbāni, so saddhāhattho gahitoyeva hotīti tato anaññāni saddhindriyasaddhābalāni tattha antogadhāni honti. Tesaṃ atthitāyā ti saddhindriyasaddhābalachandiddhipādānaṃ atthitāya sīlassa atthibhāvato tividhenapi sīlena te tayopi gahitāti tattha antogadhā. Cittasamādhī ti cittiddhipādaṃ vadati. ‘‘Cittaṃ paññañca bhāvaya’’nti (saṃ. ni. 1.23, 192) hi cittamukhena samādhi vuttoti samādhimukhena cittampi vattabbataṃ arahati. Cittiddhipādabhāvanāya pana samādhipi adhimatto hotīti vīmaṃsiddhipādādivacanaṃ viya cittiddhipādavacanaṃ avatvā idha ‘‘cittasamādhī’’ ti vuttaṃ. ‘‘Pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyatī’’ti (dī. ni. 3.359; saṃ. ni. 5.376; a. ni. 3.96; 11.12) vacanato samādhiupakārā pītipassaddhiyo, tasmā samādhiggahaṇena gahitā, upekkhā pana samādhiupakārakato taṃsadisakiccato ca, tasmā sammāsamādhivasena etesaṃ antogadhatā daṭṭhabbā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 于内外十二处，依欲爱、有爱、无有爱，有十二组三法，成三十六种爱行。或如《小事分别》(Khuddakavatthuvibhaṅga)所来之理，不触及时分而说。观神足等菩提分法，因作用各异而分别说，然义理为一，故以正见为首而摄入其中。三出离寻等，于世间刹那，依与无贪、慈、悲相应而有别；于道刹那，依断灭贪、瞋、害，三者亦说为一。此理亦通于正语等。于少欲知足者，因正命得以生起，故应知彼等亦摄于其中。纵在来生，纵为生命，圣者亦不违越，故于圣者所喜之正语等戒，当以信之手执取；信手既已执取，则与此不二之信根、信力亦摄于其中。因彼等之存在，即信根、信力、欲神足之存在，故戒亦存在；由三种戒，彼三者亦被执取，故摄于其中。‘心定’，是指心神足。‘修习心与慧’（《相应部》1.23, 192），是以心说定，故亦可以定说心。然因修习心神足，定亦增上，故此处不说‘心神足’，如说‘观神足’等，而说‘心定’。依‘有喜者身轻安，身轻安者受乐，有乐者心入定’（《长部》3.359；《相应部》5.376；《增支部》3.96, 11.12）之语，喜与轻安资助定，故为定所摄；舍则因资助定且作用相似，故亦为定所摄。是故应知，彼等皆因正定而摄入其中。
entries.english: In the twelve internal and external sense bases, there are thirty-six courses of craving, as twelve triads based on craving for sensual pleasures, craving for existence, and craving for non-existence. Or, they are stated without touching upon the division by time, in accordance with the method that comes in the Khuddakavatthuvibhaṅga. The wings to awakening, such as the bases for spiritual power beginning with discrimination, are spoken of with a diversity of function, but in meaning they are one, included therein by way of right view. The three thoughts of renunciation, etc., are distinct at the mundane moment through their association with non-greed, loving-kindness, and compassion, but at the path moment, through the eradication of greed, ill will, and cruelty, they are also spoken of as one. The same principle applies to right speech, etc. But since right livelihood arises in one who has few wishes and is content, their inclusion should be understood through that. Because right speech and the other virtues, which are dear to the noble ones, are not to be transgressed by them even in another existence or for the sake of life, by grasping them with the hand of faith, that hand of faith is itself grasped; thus the faith faculty and the faith power, not being other than that, are included therein. Because of their existence—that is, because of the existence of the faith faculty, the faith power, and the basis for spiritual power consisting of zeal—virtue exists; thus, by the threefold virtue, those three are grasped and are included therein. "Concentration of mind" refers to the basis for spiritual power consisting of mind. For it is said, "Develop mind and wisdom," where concentration is spoken of by way of the mind; thus, the mind also deserves to be spoken of by way of concentration. But since concentration becomes pre-eminent in the development of the basis for spiritual power consisting of mind, instead of saying "the basis for spiritual power consisting of mind," as one might say "the basis for spiritual power consisting of discrimination," here it is called "concentration of mind." Based on the statement, "For one with a joyful mind, the body becomes tranquil; with a tranquil body, one feels pleasure; for one who is happy, the mind becomes concentrated," joy and tranquility are assistants to concentration; therefore, they are included by the term concentration. Equanimity, however, is included because it assists concentration and because its function is similar. Therefore, their inclusion by way of right concentration should be understood.

entries.pali: 522 . Lokiyāyapi…pe… āhā ti idaṃ vipassanābhāvanāya satipaṭṭhānādayo ekasmiṃ ārammaṇe saha nappavattanti, pavattamānānipi indriyabalāni bojjhaṅgesveva antogadhāni honti. Pītisambojjhaṅgaggahaṇena hi tadupanissayabhūtaṃ saddhindriyaṃ saddhābalañca gahitameva hoti ‘‘saddhūpanisaṃ pāmojja’’nti (saṃ. ni. 2.23) vuttattā. Maggaṅgāni pañceva vipassanākkhaṇe pavattantīti imamatthaṃ sandhāya vuttanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 522. 世间的……乃至……说，此谓在观（vipassanā）修习中，念处等法不会在一个所缘上同时生起，即使生起，诸根与诸力亦皆包含在觉支之中。因把握喜觉支，即等于把握以其为所依的信根与信力，正如‘信为喜悦之近因’（《相应部》2.23）所说。当知，此处是指只有五种道支在观的刹那生起，此乃所要表达之要点。
entries.english: 522. He says, 'Even in the mundane...'—here, the foundations of mindfulness and so on, in insight meditation, do not arise simultaneously on a single object; and even when they arise, the faculties and powers are included within the enlightenment factors. For by the inclusion of the enlightenment factor of joy, the faculty of faith and the power of faith, which are its supporting conditions, are already included, as it is said: 'Joy has faith as its decisive support' (Saṃyutta Nikāya 2.23). It should be understood that this statement—that only five path factors arise in the moment of insight—is made with this meaning in mind.

entries.pali: Ekattā ti ekabhāvato ekopi vutto. Tayo ti kiccavibhāgena. Tānī ti sammāvācādisīlāni. Chandassa saddahanānukūlāpi chandanavasena pavatti hotīti saddhindriyasaddhābalehi saddhiṃ chandiddhipādo vutto. Tādise kāle upekkhānimittānubrūhanena upakārā samādhissa samavāhitāvasena tādisakiccāva upekkhā veditabbā.
entries.chinese_simplified: “一”（ekatta），因其单一性而说为一。“三”（taya），是依作用之差别而说。“彼等”，是指正语等戒（sammāvācādisīla）。欲（chanda）之生起，既随顺于信解（saddahanānukūla），又依欲力而转（chandanavasena pavatti），是故欲如意足（chandiddhipāda）与信根（saddhindriya）、信力（saddhābala）一并宣说。于此时，通过培育舍相（upekkhānimitta）而助益于定（samādhi），应知此舍因其平衡作用（samavāhitāvasena）而有如是功能。
entries.english: 'As one' means it is also called one from being of a single nature. 'As three' means by division of function. 'Those' refers to the virtues such as right speech. Because the arising of desire is also conducive to belief and occurs through the influence of desire, the basis of spiritual power that is desire is mentioned together with the faculty of faith and the power of faith. At such a time, equanimity should be understood as having that very function, being an aid to concentration through the cultivation of the sign of equanimity, due to its bringing about balance.

entries.pali: 19 . Nava balāni – saddhābalaṃ vīriyabalaṃ satibalaṃ samādhibalaṃ paññābalaṃ hiribalaṃ ottappabalaṃ ahirikabalaṃ anottappabalaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 19. 九力(bala)：信力(saddhābala)、精进力(vīriyabala)、念力(satibala)、定力(samādhibala)、慧力(paññābala)、惭力(hiribala)、愧力(ottappabala)、无惭力(ahirikabala)、无愧力(anottappabala)。
entries.english: 19. Nine powers: the power of faith, the power of energy, the power of mindfulness, the power of concentration, the power of wisdom, the power of moral shame, the power of moral dread, the power of shamelessness, and the power of fearlessness of wrongdoing.

entries.pali: 34 . Pañca balāni – saddhābalaṃ vīriyabalaṃ satibalaṃ samādhibalaṃ paññābalaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 34. 五力(balāni)：信力、精进力、念力、定力、慧力。
entries.english: 34. Five powers: the power of faith, the power of energy, the power of mindfulness, the power of concentration, and the power of wisdom.

entries.pali: 40 . ‘‘Sattadhā tattha saṅgaho’’ti vatvāna puna taṃ dassetuṃ ‘‘saṅkappapassaddhi cā’’ tyādi vuttaṃ . Tattha vīriyaṃ navaṭṭhānaṃ sammappadhānacatukkavīriyiddhipādavīriyindriyavīriyabalasambojjhaṅgasammāvāyāmavasena navakiccattā, sati aṭṭhaṭṭhānā satipaṭṭhānacatukkasatindriyasatibalasatisambojjhaṅgasammāsativasena aṭṭhakiccattā. Samādhi catuṭṭhāno samādhindriyasamādhibalasamādhisambojjhaṅgasammāsamādhivasena catukiccattā, paññā pañcaṭṭhānā vīmaṃsiddhipādapaññindriyapaññābaladhammavicayasambojjhaṅgasammādiṭṭhivasena pañcakiccattā, saddhā dviṭṭhānā saddhindriyasaddhābalavasena dvikiccattā. Eso uttamānaṃ bodhipakkhiyabhāvena visiṭṭhānaṃ sattatiṃsa dhammānaṃ pavaro uttamo vibhāgo.
entries.chinese_simplified: 40. 说了‘彼处有七种摄集’后，为了再次显示彼义，才说了‘思惟与轻安’等。其中，精进有九处，即以四正勤、精进神足、精进根、精进力、精进觉支、正精进的方式，有九种作用；念有八处，即以四念处、念根、念力、念觉支、正念的方式，有八种作用；定有四处，即以定根、定力、定觉支、正定的方式，有四种作用；慧有五处，即以观神足、慧根、慧力、择法觉支、正见的方式，有五种作用；信有二处，即以信根、信力的方式，有两种作用。此是殊胜之三十七菩提分法中，最上等的分别。
entries.english: 40. Having stated, 'There is a sevenfold grouping here,' to further illustrate that, 'intention and tranquility,' etc., is stated. In this context, energy has nine instances: the four right exertions, energy as a basis of spiritual power, the faculty of energy, the power of energy, the enlightenment factor of energy, and right effort—thus having nine functions. Mindfulness has eight instances: the four foundations of mindfulness, the faculty of mindfulness, the power of mindfulness, the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, and right mindfulness—thus having eight functions. Concentration has four instances: the faculty of concentration, the power of concentration, the enlightenment factor of concentration, and right concentration—thus having four functions. Wisdom has five instances: investigation as a basis of spiritual power, the faculty of wisdom, the power of wisdom, the enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena, and right view—thus having five functions. Faith has two instances: the faculty of faith and the power of faith—thus having two functions. This is the supreme, excellent classification of the thirty-seven states distinguished by their nature as factors of enlightenment.
